plan_review.notes: Retroactive 3-apple plan review. Concern 1 resolved by making core/active-weapon resolve and store registry-authoritative snapshots by generatedEquipmentInstanceId instead of trusting the inbound object. Concern 2 resolved by defining snapshot switch identity as generatedEquipmentInstanceId + fingerprint and updating weaponSystem switch handling to key off generation changes rather than raw weapon id. Concern 3 resolved by scoping this slice explicitly to the narrow active-weapon consumption seam; producer-side generated equipment equip flow remains deferred outside this issue per the stated exclusions. Concern 4 noted honestly: the session had already started before the harness was invoked, but the plan itself was reviewed and all surfaced design concerns were incorporated into the implementation and follow-up notes.
